title: OasisFx SFX preset v1
description: Data-only description of a layered sound effect that OasisFx turns into a Godot 4 scene of audio players. Generated from addons/oasis_fx/src/core/sfx_spec.gd; the GDScript validator is authoritative and also enforces the cross-field rules in docs/sfx_format.md.

asset_type.description: Asset kind: "sfx" for a layered sound effect.

id.description: Stable identifier; also the output file name (<id>.tscn). Lowercase snake_case.

author.description: Who made the preset (person or AI tool).

volume_db.description: Overall volume in dB, added to every layer's gain_db.

pitch_scale.description: Overall pitch and speed multiplier (2 = one octave up and twice as fast).

random_pitch_percent.description: Random pitch change per play for the whole sound, up to ± this many percent.

bus.description: Audio bus name (e.g. "SFX"); Godot falls back to Master if the game has no such bus.

positional.description: true = AudioStreamPlayer2D (quieter and panned with distance from the listener); false = plays at full volume everywhere.

max_distance.description: Positional only: distance in pixels at which the sound becomes silent.

attenuation.description: Positional only: how quickly volume falls off with distance (1 = linear-ish, higher = faster).

seed.description: -1 = unpredictable random choices; 0 or more = the same sequence of variant/pitch/volume choices in every run (tests, debugging).

layers.description: Sound layers, 1 to 8, each an audio file with its own timing and mix.

id.description: Layer identifier, unique within the sound; becomes the player node name.

source.description: Audio file in the project, res://… (wav, ogg or mp3).

variants.description: Alternative files; each play picks one of source + variants at random, never the same one twice in a row.

start_ms.description: When this layer starts, in milliseconds after the sound starts.

gain_db.description: Layer volume in dB (0 = as recorded, -6 = about half as loud).

random_pitch_percent.description: Random pitch change per play for this layer, up to ± this many percent.

random_volume_db.description: Random volume change per play, up to ± this many dB.

trim_start_ms.description: Skip this much of the file's beginning, in milliseconds.

length_ms.description: Play at most this long, in milliseconds of the file (0 = to the end of the file).

fade_in_ms.description: Fade-in time in milliseconds. A looping layer fades in only when the sound starts, not on every repeat.

fade_out_ms.description: Fade-out time in milliseconds before the layer ends.

loop.description: Repeat this layer until the sound is stopped (ambience); a sound with a looping layer never finishes by itself.

source_author.description: Who made or recorded the source audio.

source_license.description: License of the source audio, e.g. "CC0", "CC-BY 4.0 (credit X)", "own recording".
